recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, pop-surrealist portrait featuring a central figure in a distorted checkerboard suit, set against a teal digital-textured background. The aesthetic blends 1960s mod fashion with futuristic digital artifacts, characterized by saturated primary colors and sharp, geometric patterns.
coreVisualRelationships: The yellow hair anchors the top of the frame, mirroring the yellow chair wings.
The black-and-white checkerboard pattern creates a rhythmic distortion against the flat background.
The white cat-eye sunglasses provide a high-contrast focal point for the face.
The pink script typography overlaps the bold yellow block lettering for depth.
coreInvariants: Teal background with subtle horizontal scanline texture
High-saturation yellow accents in hair and furniture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered, medium shot, filling the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The face, specifically the white sunglasses and open mouth expression.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the yellow hair, moves down to the face, follows the checkerboard lines outward, and settles on the typographic elements in the upper corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Teal background in the upper third provides breathing room for text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Teal background and black/white checkerboard pattern.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant yellow hair and chair elements.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Hot pink script and deep purple lipstick.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extremely high saturation and high contrast; blacks are deep and whites are bright.

letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses ultra-bold, condensed slab-serif with minimal tracking
Secondary artist name uses wide-set geometric sans-serif
Tertiary script uses fluid, brush-style cursive
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' in the artist name is a modified chevron without a crossbar
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between heavy block letters and airy, wide-spaced sans-serif, tied together by color.
graphicDevices: Red 'REC' indicator in top left corner
Horizontal digital scanlines across the background

preserve: Contrast between blocky and script fonts
avoid: Serif fonts with high stroke contrast

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed slab-serif feel of the main title.
Matches the wide, geometric sans-serif used for the artist name.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a person with bright yellow finger-wave hair wearing white cat-eye sunglasses and a black-and-white checkerboard trench coat with exaggerated shoulders. The person should be sitting in a yellow velvet armchair against a teal background with horizontal digital scanline textures. High contrast studio lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a wide-spaced yellow geometric sans-serif name in the top left. Place a large, condensed yellow block-letter title in the top right, with a smaller pink brush-script word overlapping it horizontally.

verificationChecks: Is the checkerboard pattern distorted by the garment's folds?
Is the hair a saturated, unnatural yellow?
Does the background have a visible digital texture?
Is the typography positioned in the upper corners?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the teal background saturation
Thickness of the pink script font
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title text
Any specific brand logos on the clothing
The exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the yellow of the hair matches the yellow of the text.
Check that the checkerboard pattern does not look like a flat texture overlay.
Verify the 'REC' dot is a vibrant red.
Confirm the teal background has horizontal scanlines.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine 1960s mod patterns with 1990s digital video artifacts and 2010s high-saturation pop-art color blocking.
